6011-the-little-lady-of-lagunitas-a-fran.title: The Little Lady Of Lagunitas A Franco Californian Romance
6011-the-little-lady-of-lagunitas-a-fran.creator: Richard Henry Savage
6011-the-little-lady-of-lagunitas-a-fran.description: A book by Richard Henry Savage. or the delivering of the great treasure fields of the West to the leaders of Secession. How their designs on this grand domain failed; what might have been, had the South been more active in its hour of primary victory and seized the Golden West, these pages may show. The golden days of the "stars and bars" were lost by the activity of the Unionists and the mistaken policy at Richmond.

arxiv-1907-11522.title: Dust-acoustic envelope solitons and rogue waves in an electron depleted plasma Journal: “Physics"
arxiv-1907-11522.creator: J. Akter ∗,1 , N. A. Chowdhury ∗∗,1 , and A. A. Mamun 1,2
arxiv-1907-11522.description: Abstract Theoretical investigation of the nonlinear propagation and modulational instability (MI) of the dust acoustic (DA) waves (DAWs) in an unmagnetized electron depleted dusty plasma (containing opposite polarity warm dust grains and non-extensive positive ions) has been made by deriving a nonlinear Schrödinger equation with the help of perturbation method.

arxiv-2011-12166.title: Scale setting the Möbius domain wall fermion on gradient-flowed HISQ action using the omega baryon mass and the gradient-flow scales t 0 t_{0} and w 0 w_{0} Preprint: LLNL-JRNL-816949, RIKEN-iTHEMS-Report-20, JLAB-THY-20-3290
arxiv-2011-12166.creator: Nolan Miller, Logan Carpenter, Evan Berkowitz, Chia Cheng Chang (張家丞), Ben Hörz, Dean Howarth, Henry Monge-Camacho, Enrico Rinaldi, David A. Brantley, Christopher Körber, Chris Bouchard, M.A. Clark, Arjun Singh Gambhir, Christopher J. Monahan, Amy Nicholson, Pavlos Vranas, André Walker-Loud
arxiv-2011-12166.description: Abstract We report on a subpercent scale determination using the omega baryon mass and gradient-flow methods. The calculations are performed on 22 ensembles of N f = 2 + 1 + 1 N_{f}=2+1+1 highly improved, rooted staggered sea-quark configurations generated by the MILC and CalLat Collaborations.

arxiv-2212-09022.title: Weyl’s Lemma on R ​ C ​ D ​ ( K , N ) RCD(K,N) Metric Measure Spaces
arxiv-2212-09022.creator: Yu Peng, Hui-Chun Zhang, Xi-Ping Zhu
arxiv-2212-09022.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yu Peng, Hui-Chun Zhang, Xi-Ping Zhu. In this paper, we extend the classical Weyl’s lemma to R ​ C ​ D ​ ( K , N ) RCD(K,N) metric measure spaces. As its applications, we show the local regularity of solutions for Poisson equations and a Liouville-type result for L 1 L^{1} very weak harmonic functions on R ​ C ​ D ​ ( K , N ) RCD(K,N) spaces.

arxiv-2301-07199.title: The JWST Early Release Science Program for Direct Observations of Exoplanetary Systems: Recommendations for Best Practices for Data Collection in Cycle 2 and Beyond
arxiv-2301-07199.creator: Sasha Hinkley, Beth Biller, Andrew Skemer, Aarynn L. Carter, Julien Girard, Dean Hines, Jens Kammerer, Jarron Leisenring, William Balmer, Elodie Choquet, Maxwell A. Millar-Blanchaer, Marshall Perrin, Laurent Pueyo, Jason Wang, Kimberly Ward-Duong, Anthony Boccaletti, Brittany Miles, Polychronis Pata
arxiv-2301-07199.description: Abstract We present a set of recommended best practices for JWST data collection for members of the community focussed on the direct imaging and spectroscopy of exoplanetary systems. These findings and recommendations are based on the early analysis of the JWST Early Release Science Program 1386, “High-Contrast Imaging of Exoplanets and Exoplanetary Systems with JWST.

arxiv-2301-11794.title: Thermodynamic features of the 1D dilute Ising model in the external magnetic field Journal: Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials
arxiv-2301-11794.creator: A.V. Shadrin, Yu.D. Panov
arxiv-2301-11794.description: Abstract We consider the effects of the magnetic field on the frustrated phase states of the dilute Ising chain, especially, the behavior of the magnetic entropy change and the isentropic dependence of the temperature on the magnetic field, which are the key parameters of the magnetocaloric effect.

arxiv-2307-16230.title: An Unforgeable Publicly Verifiable Watermark for Large Language Models
arxiv-2307-16230.creator: Aiwei Liu, Leyi Pan, Xuming Hu, Shu’ang Li, Lijie Wen, Irwin King, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2307-16230.description: Abstract Recently, text watermarking algorithms for large language models (LLMs) have been proposed to mitigate the potential harms of text generated by LLMs, including fake news and copyright issues. However, current watermark detection algorithms require the secret key used in the watermark generation process, making them susceptible to security breaches and counterfeiting during public detection.

arxiv-2401-16019.title: Acceleration and transport of relativistic electrons in the parsec-scale jets of the microquasar SS 433
arxiv-2401-16019.creator: H.E.S.S. Collaboration
arxiv-2401-16019.description: Abstract SS 433 is a microquasar, a stellar binary system with collimated relativistic jets. We observed SS 433 in gamma rays using the High Energy Stereoscopic System (H.E.S.S.), finding an energy-dependent shift in the apparent position of the gamma-ray emission of the parsec-scale jets.

arxiv-2501-01115.title: Co-Design of a Robot Controller Board and Indoor Positioning System for IoT-Enabled Applications
arxiv-2501-01115.creator: Ali Safa 1 , Ali Al-Zawqari 2
arxiv-2501-01115.description: Abstract This paper describes the development of a cost-effective yet precise indoor robot navigation system composed of a custom robot controller board and an indoor positioning system. First, the proposed robot controller board has been specially designed for emerging IoT-based robot applications and is capable of driving two 6-Amp motor channels.

arxiv-2506-11816.title: Gauge-invariant Wigner equation for electromagnetic fields: Strong and weak formulation
arxiv-2506-11816.creator: Clemens Etl, Mauro Ballicchia, Mihail Nedjalkov, Hans Kosina
arxiv-2506-11816.description: Abstract Gauge-invariant Wigner theory describes the quantum-mechanical evolution of charged particles in the presence of an electromagnetic field in phase space, which is spanned by position and kinetic momentum. This approach is independent of the chosen potentials, as it depends only on the electric and magnetic field variables.

arxiv-2508-12907.title: SNAP-UQ: Self-supervised Next-Activation Prediction for Single-Pass Uncertainty in TinyML
arxiv-2508-12907.creator: Ismail Lamaakal, Chaymae Yahyati, Khalid El Makkaoui, Ibrahim Ouahbi, Yassine Maleh
arxiv-2508-12907.description: Abstract We introduce SNAP-UQ , a single-pass, label-free uncertainty method for TinyML that estimates risk from depth-wise next-activation prediction : tiny int8 heads forecast the statistics of the next layer from a compressed view of the previous one, and a lightweight monotone mapper turns the resulting surprisal into an actionable score.

pennsylvania-charter-liberties-1701.description: William Penn's 1701 Charter of Privileges (Charter of Liberties) for Pennsylvania.

pmc-10478421.title: Understanding the effects of universal test and treat on longitudinal HIV care outcomes among South African youth: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10478421.creator: Lindsey M Filiatreau, Jessie K Edwards, Nkosinathi Masilela, F Xavier Gómez-Olivé, Nicole Haberland, Brian W Pence, Joanna Maselko, Kathryn E Muessig, Chodziwadziwa Whiteson Kabudula, Mi-Suk Kang Dufour, Sheri A Lippman, Kathleen Kahn, Audrey Pettifor
pmc-10478421.description: IntroductionLittle is known about the effects of universal test and treat (UTT) policies on HIV care outcomes among youth living with HIV (YLHIV). Moreover, there is a paucity of information regarding when YLHIV are most susceptible to disengagement from care under the newest treatment guidelines.

pmc-10530945.title: Remodeling of Tumor Microenvironment by Nanozyme Combined cGAS–STING Signaling Pathway Agonist for Enhancing Cancer Immunotherapy
pmc-10530945.creator: Wenpei Dong, Mengting Chen, Chun Chang, Tao Jiang, Li Su, Changpo Chen, Guisheng Zhang, Liangcan He, Jing Mu
pmc-10530945.description: Nanozymes and cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS) the stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling pathway, as powerful organons, can remodel the tumor microenvironment (TME) to increase efficacy and overcome drug resistance in cancer immunotherapy. Nanozymes have the potential to manipulate the TME by producing reactive oxygen species (ROS), which lead to positive oxidative stress in tumor cells.

pmc-10548098.title: Migratory patterns of two major influenza virus host species on tropical islands
pmc-10548098.creator: Camille Lebarbenchon, Solenn Boucher, Chris Feare, Muriel Dietrich, Christine Larose, Laurence Humeau, Matthieu Le Corre, Audrey Jaeger
pmc-10548098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Animal migration is a major driver of infectious agent dispersal. Duck and seabird migrations, for instance, play a key role in the spatial transmission dynamics and gene flow of avian influenza viruses (AIV), worldwide. On tropical islands, brown and lesser noddies (Anous stolidus and Anous tenuirostris) may be important AIV hosts, but the lack of knowledge on their migratory behaviour limits our understanding of virus circulation in island networks.

pmc-11444773.title: Fertility loss and recovery dynamics after repeated heat stress across life stages in male Drosophila melanogaster: patterns and processes
pmc-11444773.creator: Abhishek Meena, Alessio N De Nardo, Komal Maggu, Sonja H Sbilordo, Jeannine Roy, Rhonda R Snook, Stefan Lüpold
pmc-11444773.description: Frequent and extreme temperatures associated with climate change pose a major threat to biodiversity, particularly for organisms whose metabolism is strictly linked to ambient temperatures. Many studies have explored thermal effects on survival, but heat-induced fertility loss is emerging as a greater threat to population persistence.

pmc-11481550.title: Medical service satisfaction and depression among middle-aged and older Chinese adults: moderating role of distinct Internet-using patterns
pmc-11481550.creator: Lunxin Liu, Boya Liu, Jing Zheng, Lang Wang, Zhiliu Liao, Hong Xu
pmc-11481550.description: BackgroundPatient satisfaction is a powerful predictor of an individual's mental health, according to previous research. However, there has not been a thorough study on the relationship between depression and overall medical service satisfaction (OMSS) in middle-aged and older adults. Moreover, little is known about how different Internet-using patterns affect this relationship.

pmc-12451387.title: Working donkey welfare assessment and owner survey in Meru County, Kenya
pmc-12451387.creator: Martha Mellish, Jason Stull
pmc-12451387.description: There are significant welfare concerns regarding the plight of working donkeys (Equus asinus) in developing countries. To-date, however, there has been limited work assessing the welfare of donkeys in many parts of Africa, including Kenya. This study aimed to characterise the unique welfare concerns of working donkeys in Meru County, Kenya.

pmc-12649472.title: Acoustic Identity: Linking Signature Whistles and Visual Identification in a Threatened Dolphin Population
pmc-12649472.creator: Amber Crittenden, Kate Robb, Christine Erbe, José Raduan Jaber Mohamad
pmc-12649472.description: Simple SummaryAcoustic identity is an essential element of dolphin interaction, achieved through the production of a “signature whistle” unique to each individual. These whistles are often complex and emitted repetitively. Using distinct whistle characteristics, researchers have identified 22 unique signature whistles within acoustic recordings collected in the presence of 57 Burrunan dolphins.

pmc-12705457.title: Obesity due to MC4R deficiency is associated with reduced cholesterol, triglycerides and cardiovascular disease risk
pmc-12705457.creator: Stefanie Zorn, Rebecca Bounds, Alice Williamson, Katherine Lawler, Ruth Hanssen, Julia Keogh, Elana Henning, Miriam Smith, Barbara A. Fielding, A. Margot Umpleby, Summaira Yasmeen, Maria Marti-Solano, Claudia Langenberg, Martin Wabitsch, Tinh-Hai Collet, I. Sadaf Farooqi
pmc-12705457.description: Obesity causes dyslipidemia and is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease. However, the mechanisms coupling weight gain and lipid metabolism are poorly understood. Brain melanocortin 4 receptors (MC4Rs) regulate body weight and lipid metabolism in mice, but the relevance of these findings to humans is unclear.

pmc-12834553.title: Dietary metal chelator, phytochelatin 2, increases selenium and alters metal homeostasis and associated lipid metabolism in the liver
pmc-12834553.creator: Zachery R Jarrell, Ho Young Lee, Choon-Myung Lee, Michael L Orr, Dean P Jones, Young-Mi Go
pmc-12834553.description: Biological systems have evolved highly regulated systems to ensure homeostatic levels of trace minerals, such as selenium (Se), which are important to metabolic function and signaling. Much of the understanding of these systems is limited to endogenous proteins and small molecules used for trafficking of minerals.

pmc-13274921.title: A tti1 mutation in the Tel2-Tti1-Tti2 complex specifically eliminates the cellular function of Rad3ATR, but not that of other PIKKs in fission yeast
pmc-13274921.creator: Sankhadip Bhadra, Nafees Ahamad, Saman Khan, Yong-jie Xu, Dmitry Gordenin, Giovanni Bosco, Giovanni Bosco, Giovanni Bosco

pmc-13294000.title: Druggable β-catenin palmitoyl-switch coordinates immune evasion via immunogenic ferroptosis resistance and PD-L1-mediated immunosuppression
pmc-13294000.creator: Qiang Zhang, Yue Kong, Yinglin Long, Xue Li, Liang Wang, Zhanhao Luo, Xiaoya Yang, Yanchun Xie, Quanwei Yu, Jing Yu, Dayi Liang, Wenhao Yuan, Xiaomin Cheng, Yaqi Su, Kaisa Cui, Guobao Tian, Zhen He, Ping Lan
pmc-13294000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryImmune evasion remains a major challenge in colorectal cancer (CRC) treatment. Here, we identify that druggable β-catenin palmitoylation at cysteine 466 (C466) by ZDHHC5 acts as a competitive switch, displacing S-nitrosylation and coordinating an immunosuppressive program. The palmitoylated state stabilizes the β-catenin/TCF4 complex, which simultaneously upregulates SLC7A11 to suppress immunogenic ferroptosis, critical for CD8+ T cell priming, and PD-L1 to inhibit cytotoxic CD8+ T cells, thereby impairing both the initiation and effector phases of anti-tumor immunity.

pmc-13314735.title: Comparing two methods to quantify physical resilience
pmc-13314735.creator: Heather E. Whitson, Marissa Ashner, Virginia B. Kraus, Sarah Peskoe, Janet L. Huebner, Corey B. Simon, Katherine Hall, Cathleen Colon-Emeric

pmc-13460416.title: Metric Anatomy of Pain: A Critical Analysis of Assessment Tools in Algological Practice
pmc-13460416.creator: Juan J Valero Quintero, Héctor Aceituno, Luisana Maldonado-De Santiago, Jennifer Vela-Poveda, José Vásconez-Fabre
pmc-13460416.description: Pain assessment conditions the quality of the therapeutic process in a context reshaped by the 2020 International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) definitional update, the 2017 introduction of the nociplastic mechanistic descriptor, and the recognition of chronic primary pain as an autonomous nosological entity in the International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision (ICD-11).

solinus-de-mirabilibus-mundi-mommsen-186.title: Solinus: De mirabilibus mundi
solinus-de-mirabilibus-mundi-mommsen-186.creator: Gaius Julius Solinus
solinus-de-mirabilibus-mundi-mommsen-186.description: Solinus's 3rd-century catalogue of the world's wonders in Mommsen's 1864 critical Latin edition — the Pliny-derived source for medieval monster races.
